integrity: Every complete strict profile through three couples is enumerated exactly. Stability and both objective values are each implemented in two independent forms; the four-couple witness is checked against all twenty-four perfect matchings.
scientific_limitations: The exhaustive census covers complete strict Stable Marriage instances through three couples. The four-couple result is an explicit sharp witness rather than a complete four-couple census.
title: Four couples are the sharp incompatibility boundary for egalitarian versus minimum-regret Stable Marriage
